item.title: I Made a Piano Cover of Fujii Kaze’s Kirari
item.description: Writing piano covers feels a bit like translation. You take a song performed by a full band and rewrite it so it makes musical sense on the piano, which gives me a sense of accomplishment.

item.title: Meet Francis Poulenc
item.description: What kind of person writes such music? What were his thoughts about music? Any composers he likes or dislikes?

item.title: Hayato Sumino’s (Cateen's) Piano Recital

item.title: 🔔 The Story Behind Bell
item.description: One day while improvising, I played the opening eight measures by chance and thought they sounded nice.
